name: Chain of Seven
tagline: Seven days, one chain. Miss a day and a link cracks, it doesn't break.
pitch: Day-2 retention is the leak. A visible weekly chain with forgiving cracks gives a reason to open the app tomorrow without the shame of a reset streak.

screens.title: The first link
screens.layout: Grey caps 13 'DAY 1'. Card with the habit name 22 and a 96 pt check button. The chain, link 1 closed, caption '1 of 7'. Home indicator.

screens.title: The chain
screens.layout: Top bar: app name 30, streak pill '3'. Seven-link chain. Card 'TONIGHT' with primary 'Log today'. Row grey 14 'Repair a crack: log 2 days in a row'. Tab bar.

screens.title: Week card
screens.layout: Card 300x533, corner 28: app name 22, '7 of 7' 40, the chain, the habit, tiny site footer. Under it: primary 'Share', secondary 'Save image'.

note.from: Duolingo's streak freeze; Apple Fitness rings close per day.

note.retention: An open link tonight; a cracked link repaired by two days in a row.
note.build: S. Logging and reminders exist; the chain is a new view.

adapt: Use the sprite's link and check icons; no new illustration. Player Maya, today Thursday.

background.oneLiner: One tap closes today's link; seven links make a week; a miss cracks a link instead of resetting.
